evidence.reason: validate_config accepts only global or specialist and _config_check raises ConfigError with PHASE2_SYMBOL_MODE for another value.
The direct Phase 2 router independently rejects an invalid resolved mode before dispatching global, so a bogus mode cannot silently fall back to global.

The global branch still constructs one Rule_Pool_Generator for each long/short direction over the pooled train and validation frames; its resume identity call at lines 3887-3893 does not add specialist symbols.
The pipeline log resolves and records symbol_mode, while the run manifest records phase2_symbol_mode at lines 1263-1271 and 1285-1295.
The effective configuration snapshot records the resolved symbol mode.

Specialist generation slices train and validation data per symbol, computes phase2_island_hyperparams from the slice row count at lines 3719-3720, and the frozen IslandHyperparams contract is defined in config.py:2421-2434.

Only a missing provenance key or a provenance value of None is annotatable. A present dict, including an empty or partial dict, must pass the required symbol, direction, specialist mode, exact built-in int version, and string-type checks at lines 2928-2965.

Resumed entries are dropped on any provenance validation failure, and the validator requires one scoped symbol matching the provenance symbol at lines 3123-3153; this closes multi-symbol and cross-symbol migration paths.
Standalone specialist loading filters resumed entries before returning them to RB.
RB's _rule_to_engine copies the nested provenance mapping and carries it through the engine rule without changing its fields.
The production-path handoff test checks provenance after standalone loading, capital normalization, and strategy construction.

checks.evidence: The fix removes coercive provenance-version parsing in both attach and validate paths (gpu_fuzzy_trader/phases/phase2_rule_pool.py:2958-2965, 3105-3112), rejects bool and int subclasses through type(v) is int, and adds OverflowError handling at the resumed-entry boundaries (:3205-3210, :3492-3507, :3744-3754). Empty and partial provenance are rejected before annotation.

The added tests call the production validator, annotator, specialist generator, standalone loader, and RB strategy path (tests/unit/test_phase2_symbol_modes.py:518-693), rather than only testing local mirrors. A small regression-coverage gap is recorded as a non-blocking finding below.

The reviewed validator is reached by specialist generation, island-artifact validation, generator resume seeding, and standalone Phase 3/4 loading (gpu_fuzzy_trader/phases/phase2_rule_pool.py:3205-3215, :3454-3457, :3744-3761; gpu_fuzzy_trader/run_pipeline.py:3115-3129). The global branch does not enter these specialist-only filters and remains unchanged in the reviewed range.

The base-to-head diff contains only gpu_fuzzy_trader/phases/phase2_rule_pool.py and tests/unit/test_phase2_symbol_modes.py. git diff --check passed, and the only working-tree item outside the reviewed commit is the allowed .opencode directory.

The implementation now distinguishes absent provenance from present empty/partial records, enforces the specialist/version contract before annotation, and keeps invalid resumed records out of RB. The routing and audit paths use the resolved mode rather than an implicit default.

adversarial_checks.risk: A rule has no provenance key or provenance=None versus provenance={}.
adversarial_checks.evidence: phase2_rule_pool.py:2915-2923 treats only the missing key or None as absent; the present-dict branch rejects missing fields at :2928-2956. Tests cover empty, missing-symbol, missing-direction, and partial records at tests/unit/test_phase2_symbol_modes.py:544-604.

adversarial_checks.risk: A cache uses version 1.5, 1.0, True, False, '1', None, or an int subclass.
adversarial_checks.evidence: Both version checks use type(proven_version) is not int plus an exact value comparison at phase2_rule_pool.py:2958-2961 and :3105-3108, so bool, subclasses, floats, strings, and None fail closed without int() coercion.

adversarial_checks.risk: A JSON-loaded Infinity provenance version reaches each resumed-entry boundary.
adversarial_checks.evidence: The exact type check raises ValueError for Infinity; drop_invalid_single_symbol_rules catches ValueError/TypeError/OverflowError at phase2_rule_pool.py:3205-3210, island-cache discard catches the same at :3492-3507, and specialist annotation catches it at :3744-3754. The standalone loader regression is at tests/unit/test_phase2_symbol_modes.py:656-693.

adversarial_checks.risk: A direct public Phase 2 call uses PHASE2_SYMBOL_MODE='bogus'.
adversarial_checks.evidence: run_pipeline.py:3547-3553 raises _cfg.ConfigError before either route; tests/unit/test_phase2_symbol_modes.py:782-790 assert that specific exception type for both private and public entry points.

adversarial_checks.risk: A canonical same-island rule is reattached and its provenance is changed before RB.
adversarial_checks.evidence: The pre-existing canonical fields are checked before attach at phase2_rule_pool.py:2924-2965, and the same-island idempotence plus RB carry-through tests cover the production helpers at tests/unit/test_phase2_symbol_modes.py:330-359 and :460-504.

adversarial_checks.risk: Independent execution of the required pytest gate.
adversarial_checks.evidence: The requested .venv pytest command was rejected by the shell permission policy. The review package reports 61 passing tests, but that claim was not treated as independent verification.

findings.title: Some explicitly named malformed-version cases lack direct regression tests
findings.reason: The coercive-version parameter list covers 1.5, 1.0, True, False, and '1', but not None or an int subclass, despite those being named adversarial cases. The direct validate_config test at lines 61-64 also still accepts any Exception, although the routing assertions at lines 782-790 use ConfigError. Production type checks cover the omitted cases, so this is a test-strength issue rather than a demonstrated runtime defect.
findings.recommendation: Add None and an int subclass to the parameterized version cases, and assert ConfigError in the direct validate_config test as well.

notes: Static review of the supplied task package, changed production code, callers, and tests found the prior blocking provenance/version and fail-closed boundary defects fixed. Independent pytest execution was unavailable because the shell policy denied the .venv command; this limitation is recorded above.
